name: Dale sign-in fields are consumer-compatible; failed probe stays quiet; completed sign-in releases once
A pending screen remains held until the screen is completed
An unknown probe remains held and emits no parent wake
An ordinary hold keeps its existing text behavior and has no automatic probe
A successful old probe cannot release a replacement hold with a different stamp
A successful old probe cannot release a hold whose probe changed
The actual asks-rule blocks duplicate and answered asks while kind, form and unavailable rules fail open
